args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after v2.3.1 was deployed to production (error rate was 0.18). I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). v2.3.0 is now serving and healthy with an error rate of 0.002. v2.3.1 is marked unhealthy in production. v2.3.1-rc was healthy only in staging and was not used. No change-manager approval was needed because v2.3.0 has a healthy production history. Follow-up: investigate the v2.3.1 failure before any redeploy.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged on-call.

- **Why v2.3.0:** It is the most recent release that was healthy in production. v2.3.1 is unhealthy in production. v2.3.1-rc was healthy only in staging, so I didn't use it.
- **Result:** checkout-api is now healthy on v2.3.0 with an error rate of 0.002, down from 0.18 on v2.3.1.
- **Approval:** No change-manager approval was needed, since v2.3.0 has a healthy production history.

The incident summary covers the rollback and notes that v2.3.1 needs investigation before any redeploy.

content.text: The most recent release that was healthy in production is v2.3.0. v2.3.1-rc was only healthy in staging, so it doesn't qualify. v2.3.0 has been healthy in production, so the change-manager approval requirement doesn't apply. Rolling back now.
